none: PAS NLM-25CA34: Roman Coin: nummus of House of Constantine from near Middle Rasen
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Fallen Horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right, possibly with sceptre, spear or standard over right shoulder. This side appears to be a regular issue. Obverse inscription: [D]N IVL[---]. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman, crude figure…
